searches.lead: Allen Cell Types Database human specimens with biophysical models. RMA query (fetched, 43 rows): http://api.brain-map.org/api/v2/data/query.json?criteria=model::NeuronalModel,rma::criteria,specimen(donor(organism[name$eq'Homo Sapiens'])),neuronal_model_template[name$il'Biophysical*'],rma::include,well_known_files(well_known_file_type),specimen(ephys_result(well_known_files(well_known_file_type))),rma::options[num_rows$eq2000] ; layer/dendrite-type join via http://api.brain-map.org/api/v2/data/query.json?criteria=model::ApiCellTypesSpecimenDetail,rma::criteria,[donor__species$eq'Homo Sapiens'],rma::options[num_rows$eq5000]. Result: ALL 43 human models are 'Biophysical - perisomatic' (template 329230710); there are ZERO human 'Biophysical - all active' models. Layer breakdown (excluding already-imported 541563728): L4 spiny 4, L5 spiny 5, L5 aspiny 1 (not a listed gap), L3 spiny 20, L3 aspiny 5, L2 sparsely-spiny 2, L2 spiny 3 (already covered class), L6 spiny 3, L1 none. Every model bundle is at http://api.brain-map.org/neuronal_model/download/{model_id} (zip with modfiles/*.mod, fit_parameters.json, reconstruction.swc, ephys_sweeps.json, manifest.json); 8 bundles were downloaded and opened here (626170709, 626170718, 626170679, 626170439, 626170670, 626170484, 538906694, 554338972): each has 16 .mod files, celsius=34.0, junction_potential=-14 and the fit sweep numbers. Every specimen has an NWBDownload well_known_file (HEAD-verified for 618205555 -> 527952752_ephys.nwb, 17.98 MB, HTTP 200). Protocol is in the Oct 2017 Electrophysiology whitepaper (https://community.brain-map.org/uploads/short-url/veJ9z4lwAJoxv4Rx23b7KpnUYEp.pdf): bath ~34 C; recordings stored UNCORRECTED for measured -14 mV liquid junction potential; a bias current is injected after break-in to hold initial RMP for the whole experiment (per-sweep values in ephys_sweeps.json / NWB); Long Square 1 s steps from -110 pA to rheobase+160 pA in 20 pA increments (some low-IR human cells -220 pA in 40 pA steps); 2 s suprathreshold squares at rheobase+40/+80 pA are the fit targets; 0.5 ms +/-200 pA pulses for capacitance. Perisomatic modelling whitepaper: https://community.brain-map.org/uploads/short-url/akP9tVfUe0X96gRnM0hFoztAZdo.pdf. Licence: Allen Institute Terms of Use (https://alleninstitute.org/terms-of-use/) - research/non-commercial use, citation required, no commercial redistribution. Priority picks: L4 pyramids 527952884/626170709 and 528015670/554338972 (fit on 4 sweeps each, MTG); L5 pyramids 527942865/626170718 and 569820026/626170475; L6 pyramids 528614014/626170679, 558211203/626170502, 548494556/626170511; L2/L3 interneurons (aspiny, subtype unknown) 571700636/626170439, 571709783/626170430, 529807751/626170661, 531520637/626170592, 488418027/543285979. Note limitations: perisomatic fits only (active conductances soma-only, passive dendrites); interneuron subtype (PV/SST/VIP) is NOT annotated for human cells; cortical layer is Allen 'structure__layer' from slice depth, region is temporal/frontal not the H01 region.

dead_ends: No human 'Biophysical - all active' models exist in the Allen Cell Types Database (all 43 human biophysical models are perisomatic; RMA query above returned only template 329230710).
No human L1 interneuron with a biophysical model (structure__layer never equals 1 among human biophysical models); L1 gap (4) cannot be filled from Allen.
Interneuron subtype (PV/SST/VIP) is not annotated for human Allen cells (no Cre line; only dendrite_type aspiny/sparsely spiny), so L2/L3 interneuron candidates are subtype-unknown.
Allen human biophysical models exist for temporal (MTG/ITG) and frontal (FroL/MFG) cortex only; none from the H01 sample's region.
The Allen 'structure' field on NeuronalModel/specimen gives gyrus only; layer must be joined from ApiCellTypesSpecimenDetail.structure__layer (done).

Old whitepaper URLs (http://help.brain-map.org/download/attachments/8323525/CellTypes_Ephys_Overview.pdf and http://www.alleninstitute.org/uploads/short-url/*.pdf) are dead (redirect to community forum / 404); working mirrors are https://community.brain-map.org/uploads/short-url/veJ9z4lwAJoxv4Rx23b7KpnUYEp.pdf (ephys) and .../akP9tVfUe0X96gRnM0hFoztAZdo.pdf (perisomatic).
One L5 aspiny human model exists (specimen 528687520, model 626170670, MTG, zip opened: 16 mods, 34 C, JP -14, fit sweep [38]) but L5 interneuron is not a listed H01 gap, so not proposed.
Only one NWB file (618205555) was HEAD-verified for a 200 response; the other NWB links were taken from the API well_known_files listing and not individually fetched.
Three L2 spiny human models (508421103/549384713, 525133308/556384280, and imported 541563728) exist but L2 pyramidal is already covered, so excluded.

searches.lead: ModelDB 267587 / Guet-McCreight et al. 2023 human L5 microcircuit (and its sibling ModelDB 267595 / Yao et al. 2022 human L2/3 microcircuit) plus the Allen Cell Types human perisomatic-model cohort those circuits were built from. Key finding on the lead: the 267587 source tree (github.com/agmccrei/HumanL5Circuit_AGM2022, GPL-3.0) contains biophys_HL5PN1y.hoc / biophys_HL5PN1o.hoc (young/old L5 pyramidal), biophys_HL5MN1.hoc, biophys_HL5VN1.hoc, biophys_HL5BN1.hoc, a mod/ directory and HL5*.swc morphologies. There is NO HL5PN2 template. Per the Cerebral Cortex methods (academic.oup.com/cercor/article/33/8/4360/6706906) the L5 pyramidal models were fitted to POOLED Krembil (Toronto MTG) whole-cell recordings (younger n=60, older n=13) plus Allen human data (n=50/14), not to a single cell; the SST (HL5MN1) and VIP (HL5VN1) models were 'derived from previous human L2/3 neuron models' because no human L5 SST/VIP data existed - i.e. they are re-badged HL23SST/HL23VIP fitted to Allen L2/L3 specimens 571700636 (SST) and 525018757 (VIP). The Krembil recordings are downloadable as NWB from DANDI 000293 (CC0-1.0); Allen recordings are NWB via the Cell Types API. So the SP6b-eligible donors from this family are: HL5PN1 (L5 pyramidal, population fit against DANDI 000293), HL23PYR (L2/3 pyramidal, population fit), HL23SST/HL5MN1 and HL23PV (L3 interneurons, single Allen cells), HL23VIP/HL5VN1 (L2 interneuron, single Allen cell); and independently the Allen human perisomatic models cover the L4 (4 cells), L5 (6), L6 (3) and L3-interneuron (5 aspiny) gaps directly.

searches.lead: Human LAYER 4 pyramidal/spiny-stellate biophysical fits. Plain answer: no bespoke, paper-level (BluePyOpt/ModelDB-style) human L4 model exists — ModelDB's 'Neocortex layer 4 pyramidal cell' list (27 entries) is entirely mouse VISp / in-vitro network models, and no Kalmbach/Berg/BBP/Segev human L4 fit could be found. BUT the Allen Cell Types Database does hold four human MTG layer-4 spiny cells with published perisomatic biophysical models (10 somatic conductances: NaTs, Nap, K_P, K_T, Kv3_1, SK, Im, Ih, Ca_HVA, Ca_LVA + CaDynamics; fit JSON + modfiles + the fitting NWB + SWC all downloadable from the same API used for the already-imported specimen 541563728), which is exactly the family the existing L2 donor came from. Those four are the only substantiated human L4 candidates. The same Allen query yields perisomatic-model donors for every other H01 gap except L1 interneuron (43 human perisomatic models total: L2 4, L3 25, L4 4, L5 6, L6 3; 6 aspiny/2 sparsely-spiny interneurons, none in L1). No human L1 interneuron model exists anywhere I could find.

Gidon 2020 ModelDB 260178 (human L2/3 dCaAP) is a Fig S12 demonstration model (_mod, _classlib), not a fit to a specific recorded cell; no data.
Eyal 2016 ModelDB 195667 human L2/3 low-Cm models: passive fits; recordings not public.
